    🎲 How to Play
    🎲
    Roll & Move
    Roll your die and move. Finish laps to convert 10 coins → 1 pizza!
    🍕
    Win Condition
    Most pizzas wins. Tie → most coins. Still tied → 1v1 minigame!
    🪙🍕💀🎮
    Basic Spaces
    🪙+2 coins · 🍕+1 pizza (need 10 coins!) · 💀-3 coins · 🎮 Minigame
    ❓🪤⚔️💰
    Special Spaces
    ❓ Event · 🪤 Trap (bad luck) · ⚔️ Challenge (1vAll) · 💰 Jackpot (grows!)
    🎲 2×
    Dice Shop & Double
    At half-laps: visit the Dice Shop! Past the midpoint all space values double!
    🦊🐻🐔🎸
    Characters & Dice
    All start with d6. Buy special dice in shop: Foxy (d8), Chica (Chef), Bonnie (Rocker) + generics
